Hi Elena,

Attaching Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.2.pdf and a DataFlow_Map_FintechCo_v1.pdf (draft) for your review. A few notes up front to help your review and speed procurement:

- Transfers: Redwood performs cross-border processing under Standard Contractual Clauses (EU SCCs) for EU->US transfers. For UK customers we offer the UK Addendum. We also provide a Data Processing Addendum that maps to the SCCs and documents our subprocessors. If your legal team prefers an alternative transfer mechanism, please flag that now.

- Subprocessors: the attached spreadsheet is our current roster. We classify subprocessors by function (hosting, monitoring, analytics). We are happy to provide a signed subprocessor attestation for any named vendor on your list; practically, we handle subprocessor notifications via the portal but can provide the doc on request.

- Execution: we typically execute DPAs via DocuSign (preferred) but can use AdobeSign if procurement insists. DocuSign is faster for routing multiple signatories.

Next steps suggested: procurement to confirm e-sign preference and any subprocessors that need to be excluded or run through a whitelist review. If your security team needs a deeper review of a vendor, send us the checklist and we will prioritize evidence.

Regards,
